content: Ecosystem search found no established Python pattern of shipping a Mapping/__getitem__ shim on a model to ease a dict->model return-type change; the strongest datapoint runs the other way (stripe-python v15 REMOVED dict behaviour from its response objects after years of collisions). Prevailing practice for return-type breaks is a versioned migration guide plus a raw-payload escape hatch (to_dict/as_dict/model_dump), not a dual-access shim. MCP python-sdk v1->v2 is the counter-example: it moved a typed field TO plain dict[str,Any] and documented dictionary access in the migration guide.
